description: The Bernstein map for f(n)=n+1 and g(n)=n+2 is the residue-class rearrangement, has first values 1,2,0,4,5,3, and is bijective although neither original map is surjective.
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.ComparingSizes.bernstein_example_values :
  (∀ (hg : Function.Injective fun n => n + 2),
      Lemmatheca.SetTheory.bernsteinMap (fun n => n + 1) (fun n => n + 2) hg =
        Lemmatheca.Entry.ComparingSizes.bernsteinExample) ∧
    List.map Lemmatheca.Entry.ComparingSizes.bernsteinExample (List.range 6) = [1, 2, 0, 4, 5, 3] ∧
      Function.Bijective Lemmatheca.Entry.ComparingSizes.bernsteinExample ∧
        (¬Function.Surjective fun n => n + 1) ∧ ¬Function.Surjective fun n => n + 2
